note 2 overlapping conductor shape(s) were merged into 1 — copper that overlaps on one level is one conductor, in 3D as in the planar model.
note Port 1 ('1') at (8.47, -5 mm) was taken to be on the conductor's low-y (bottom) end (the port's own direction), driving current in the +y direction, at 50 Ω.
note Port 1 at its line's end is a vertical lumped sheet 1680 µm (1.68 mm) wide and 762 µm (0.762 mm) tall from 'Top Copper (1 oz)' down to 'Bottom Copper (1 oz)': the nearest ground-reference plane with metal under the port.
note The air box's default padding is 14.1412 mm on every face — λ/4 at 5.3 GHz, the sweep's lowest frequency, since a radiation pattern is asked for — because a radiation pattern was asked for: its equivalence surface sits inside the absorber with room to spare around the structure. The setup names no pattern frequency, so the sweep's lowest stands in for it; state one to size the box for it. A padding the setup's AirBox states is used as stated.
note The air box's floor is below the geometry: 'Bottom Copper (1 oz)' is drawn or has metal below it, so it is geometry rather than a floor.
